1.consolidated_definition: telecom. Red que conecta o ayuda a conectar a las personas entre sí. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Quien piense que el fenómeno de social networking que contagia a todo el planeta es sólo para humanos se equivoca (El Nuevo Día, 01-10-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Telecom. Network that connects or helps to connect people with each other. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. Anyone who thinks the social networking phenomenon that is infecting the entire planet is only for humans is mistaken (El Nuevo Día, 01-10-06)
